notes: Returned Tanks se tank shift karne par ab wo tank wahan se ghaib ho jata hai aur screen khud usi plan/item par chali jati hai jahan tank bheja tha — dobara shift nahi ho sakta. Consumption History ab desktop jaisi hai: har plan, item, phase aur raw material ki tafseel, saath mein Print button — wohi PDF jo desktop se banta hai. Neeche Mega tab aya hai: baghair plan ke baray tank, department se stock kata jata hai, aur jitna chahen utna kisi plan ke item mein shift ho sakta hai, baqi Mega mein rehta hai. Shift karte hue tartib ab hamesha Plan, phir Phase, phir Item hai — phase pehle se select nahi hota. List View ab poori screen par khulti hai, upar plan badal sakte hain. Tamam quantities ab hamesha 2 decimals ke saath nazar ati hain (masalan 25.50 kg).
releaseNotes: FG Mega + History pack: M1 Returned Tanks shift fix — explicit pool membership (tank.leftover), a shifted tank leaves Returned Tanks at once and cannot be shifted twice, returns with remainder and Post re-enter tanks into the pool, screen navigates to the destination plan/item/phase after a shift; M2 mobile Consumption History mirrors desktop (per plan/item/phase/raw-material detail with effective quantities + cloth, same Print Studio consumption_history document per plan and per item, Edit/Delete/Finalized kept); M3 new Mega footer tab — plan-less bulk tanks seeded TOP + FOAM under a MEGA scope in fgConsumptionTanks, preparation deducts from the selected department, partial shifts out with provenance (basket routes back to the Mega tank), Mega never leaks into plan lists or the Returned derivation; M4 shift pickers enforce Plan > Phase > Item with no pre-selected phase; M5 current-plan List View is a full screen with header, back and a plan dropdown; M6 one shared fmtKg (exactly 2 decimals) across the FG surface + History, committed inputs rounded to 2 dp. Also fixed: fgConsumptionTanks loader dropped the store meta on load (Mega seed marker could never persist) and the first seed effect could be clobbered by the initial load (seeding is now data-driven/idempotent).
